title: Static-equivalence quotient for dynamic-owner intake
question: Can the existing R-193/R-200 static non-identifiability witness be made into a reusable quotient relation with a candidate-neutral finite separating estimand, while preserving the existing forward and inverse methods?
finding: Yes at the finite abstract-interface level: equality of the registered static signature is an equivalence relation, the class contains two distinct positive contraction representatives, and the fixed one-step proxy at (1,0) separates them. This keeps the surviving class set-valued and does not select a source-owned dynamics.
decision_reason: The source-owned Q3LOCK production map remains absent, so another finite mobility table would repeat a parked route. The quotient contract advances the named T-061 owner/observation-map packet by making the non-identifiability boundary and a separating estimand explicit and reusable.
boundary: Finite exact-rational quotient interface only. The probe is not physical time; no generator, state, projection, heat-root, filtration, raw-current map, q-ledger, observation likelihood, holdout prediction, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum or mass-gap conclusion follows.
next_action: Use the quotient as the fixed intake boundary and wait for a hash-pinned source-owned dynamics plus complete observation map. Do not add an equivalent finite mobility table; if no owner hash arrives, keep the class parked and progress other non-duplicative T-061 anchors.
method: Parse the hash-pinned R-193/R-200 authorities and the new finite contract.
Define static equivalence by equality of the static signature and check reflexive, symmetric and transitive laws.
Reconstruct A/B with exact Fractions and evaluate the fixed probe (1,0).
